about: eden:mural_panel (from #1493). A fixed wall panel. Painting it, with a hand free, sets its picture and title (both by reference) only when the work completes, and credits the painter by a link. Painting again replaces the picture and title; every painter's link stays, as the original kept the earlier provenance. Who may paint a panel someone owns (the original's 'art.not-yours') is the world's ownership rule, which the original's own review found was bypassed when the recipe was left out; here no argument skips a need.
